Always joking and it's blatantly obvious but I'm serious and professional when I need to be, I support my friends no matter what, even if I constantly insult them. Almost everyone I know is like this, and I've lived in two different cities and been to uni so I know a wide variety of people. Never had any problem with it, I'm always open and honest about who I am. I've always thought this was perfectly normal. I lost it at one of my colleagues yesterday after work who said 'yeah you're an AH and just can't be nice to people' because that's so untrue. My way of of being friendly and nice is by being a cunt, everyone back home knows that and are the same. I don't want to change who I am but I just feel I don't fit in - hardly anybody shares similar interests or humour. Americans can't drink so I can't even bond with people that way to maybe get them to see it's just who I am. Having seen how fake so many people are, I can guarantee I'm a more caring, loyal individual than most of them. They all love to talk the talk but at the end of the day, most of them are snakes anyway. I love my work and there's so so much more career potential for what I do in the US. I don't want to go back home but I feel I have to. Am I an AH for just being me?
